requirements.text: Allow customers to book appointments online at any time.
Provide a clear list of services offered.
Allow customers to select their preferred barber.
Show real-time availability of time slots to prevent double bookings.
Allow customers to cancel or reschedule appointments without needing to call.
Send automatic reminders via SMS and email 24 hours and 1 hour before the appointment.
Send a confirmation message immediately after booking.
Each barber must have their own login to manage their schedules.
Barbers must be able to update their availability in real time.
Ensure instant updates to customer-facing availability based on barber changes.
Provide a cost-effective solution that fits within the budget of a small business.
Ensure smooth integration with existing tools, like the point-of-sale system.
Comply with data protection regulations regarding customer information.
Provide a user-friendly interface that minimizes training for staff and customers.
